tools.name: search_apartments
tools.description: Find apartments for rent right now in New York City. Returns live listings with rent, bedrooms, move-in date, the building's tenant rating and a link to each apartment on Openigloo.

tools.name: nearby_apartments
tools.description: Live alternatives near an apartment: similar rent and size in the same area. Use it when an apartment is rented or the renter wants more options. Pass an apartment id or openigloo.com/unit link.

tools.name: building_report
tools.description: What a NYC building is like: tenant rating and review summary, open HPD violations, evictions, housing-court cases, bedbug reports, rent stabilization, who owns and manages it, and apartments for rent there. Pass a building id, an openigloo.com link, or a NYC street address.

tools.name: get_apartment
tools.description: Details of one apartment on Openigloo: whether it is still for rent, rent, move-in date, lease length, description and photos. Pass an apartment id from a search result or an openigloo.com/unit link.

tools.name: landlord_report
tools.description: What a NYC landlord or management company is like: tenant ratings across its buildings, review summary, violations, evictions and housing-court cases, its buildings and apartments for rent. Pass a landlord id from building_report or an openigloo.com/contact link.
